description.en: A pinnate fossil frond divides into two main arms near its base.
description.zh: 羽状化石叶近基部叉分为两条主臂。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Dicroidium, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Dicroidium 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Basal Y-shaped rachis is a structural difference from the existing single-axis fern fronds.
distinctness.zh: 基部Y形叶轴在结构上区别于现有单轴蕨叶。

modeling_brief.en: Start with the primary Y fork and paired leaf-bearing arms; choose one published pinnule form rather than a taxon mixture.
modeling_brief.zh: 先构建主Y叉和两条带叶臂，采用一种已发表小羽片形，不混合分类群。

uncertainty: Organ associations vary; Umkomasia and Pteruchus are not separately counted.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit. Organ-association deduplication exclusions: Umkomasia (associated ovulate organ; not a synonym); Pteruchus (associated pollen organ; not a synonym). These labels are not synonyms or additional assets.

sources.title: Contributions to the whole-plant reconstruction of Dicroidium
sources.supports: Forked foliage and associations of Dicroidium-bearing seed plants.
